text:
Elena: proposal  trim next sprint to a tight Optimize MVP: eval-triggered alerts + deterministic quant recommendations. Move adaptive batching and cache-eviction heuristics to next cycle. Quick takes?

Raj: pragmatic. We avoid heavy infra churn. Need clear alert firing rules, dedupe, and a dry-run mode for customers.

Maya: quant recs should be rule-based for now. Suggest INT8 if p99 latency improves >=10% and eval-concordance drop <=1.5%. Include throughput uplift and short risk note.

Jon: CS input  our pilot customer (LexaHealth) wants preview mode + email webhook to CS ops before live alerts. They also want per-model thresholds.

Elena: draft ACs: 1) Alerts emitted within 60s of eval-run completion for flagged orgs. 2) Per-org/per-model thresholds configurable. 3) Payload: eval_run_id, model id/version, metric deltas, top 6 failing example ids + short diffs, link to report. 4) Noise controls: dedupe window (default 10m), per-org rate-limit (default 4/hr), and dry_run option. 5) Retention: events 120d, aggregates 365d. 6) Canary: feature-flag gated, LexaHealth opt-in.

Raj: infra asks: event schema, an alert_summary index for quick queries, and a circuit-breaker if an org fires >400 alerts/day. Will implement endpoints feature-flag gated.

Maya: recommender output: recommendation type, expected p99 change, throughput uplift percent, token-cost delta, short list of potential failure modes. Advisory only, no auto-apply.

Jon: CS will coordinate LexaHealth onboarding and request dry-run email webhooks. Also ask Sales to delay external comms until canary shows 2 weeks stable.

ff-bot: feature flag created: optimize_eval_alerts_mvp (id: ff-6107) :white_check_mark:

Elena: Plan of record: ship eval-triggered alerts (MVP) + rule-based quant recommendations; defer batching and cache-eviction. Action items: PM add tickets + ACs; Eng build API + dry-run UI + retention hooks; ML implement rule-based recommender; CS onboard LexaHealth for canary.

Quick curl to enable canary:
curl -X POST "https://console.redwood.ai/api/v1/feature-flags" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"flag":"optimize_eval_alerts_mvp","enabled":true,"targets":[{"org":"lexahealth"}],"dry_run":true}'

Raj: I'll scope telemetry + index changes; target minimal E2E for canary in 2 sprints.

Elena: thanks everyone  I'll update the roadmap board and move batching/cache heuristics to Backlog. :thumbsup:
